description: Five basics of whether AI systems can read a website, checked instantly from its public pages: AI crawlers allowed in robots.txt, an llms.txt, Organization and FAQ structured data, and a title and description. Free, no score, nothing stored. For the full audit — scored out of 100 and reviewed by a person — use request_audit.

website.description: The site to check. A domain is enough, e.g. "example.com".
